about.title: Step to the Future
about.p1: On February 14, 2025, during an open dialogue with the nation's youth, the head of our state highlighted three pivotal decisions initiating a brand-new era for youth entrepreneurship.
about.p2: To ensure the implementation of these initiatives, the 'Step to the Future' center was inaugurated at Kokand University, dedicated to advancing graduate employability and market-aligned vocational competencies.
about.p3: Graduating students can scale their innovative 'Start-up' initiatives through the specialized support of the center.
